title: feat: auto-register node replacements from custom node JSON files (CORE-83)
key_points: Custom node authors can ship a `node_replacements.json` in their repo root to define node replacements declaratively.
ComfyUI reads these files and registers entries via the existing `NodeReplaceManager` during custom node loading in `nodes.py`.
No Python code needed — just a JSON file matching the `NodeReplace.as_dict()` format.
Adds robust error handling for invalid JSON, non-object files, and malformed entries which are logged and skipped gracefully.
13 unit tests covering all edge cases were added.
limitations: Only tested with custom nodes — behavior with API nodes unknown.
Does not cover registration via Python-based methods like `comfy_extras/nodes_replacements.py`.
Scope limited to the feature's implementation and integration in ComfyUI.
asserts: The PR enables custom node authors to define replacements without writing Python code by auto-registering them from JSON files.
scope: This feature applies to custom nodes within the ComfyUI system, enabling developers to ship declarative replacement mappings via `node_replacements.json` files in their repositories' root directories.
